t: When you have run out of people to ask
a: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
p: Wa in yamsaska-llāhu bi-ḍurrin fa-lā kāshifa lahu illā huw…
m: And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
